parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the application name on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page of the ApsaraVideo Live console.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500. Valid values: integers from 1 to 500.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

>  The start time must be in the last seven days.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the records of successful or failed callbacks. Valid values:

*   success
*   failed

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. You can view the stream name on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page of the ApsaraVideo Live console.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-streams-notify-records --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name push.example1.com --app-name app --stream-name stream --status success --start-time 2017-12-10T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T09:00:00Z --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamsNotifyRecords --region cn-hangzhou --Status success --StreamName stream --EndTime '2017-12-10T09:00:00Z' --PageSize 20 --DomainName 'push.example1.com' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2017-12-10T08:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName app
